scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,web,mobile --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
